pages.text: $(thing)The Aether$() is a dimension of floating islands above a sea of clouds. It has its own mobs, materials and three dungeons.
To get there, build a frame of $(item)Glowstone$() and place water in it. The portal swirls blue. The mod can also give new players a portal frame item, set by config.

pages.title: Aether Portal Frame
pages.text: Glowstone frame plus water makes the portal.

pages.title: Holystone
pages.text: The Aether's main stone. Dungeons use Carved, Angelic and Hellfire stone and need Bronze, Silver and Gold keys.

pages.title: Zanite Gemstone
pages.text: The Aether's tool and armor gem. Gravitite and Valkyrie gear come later.

pages.title: Ambrosium Shard
pages.text: Lights Aether furnaces and heals. Golden Amber comes from golden oak trees.
The Aether's dungeons hold keys and a boss each: Bronze, Silver and Gold, ending in the Slider, Valkyrie Queen and Sun Spirit. Parachute items make falling off the islands survivable.

pages.title: Cold Parachute
pages.text: A parachute for falling off the islands. A Golden Parachute is the sturdier version.

Gear from the Aether stacks with other mods. The Invisibility Cloak toggles with = by default here. Bosses are in $(l:exploration/bosses)Bosses$(/l); travel is in $(l:exploration/dimensions)Dimensions$(/l).
